ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.
